review.notes: Full review. Seeded sample: all 15 targets read against their sources (1.6, 2.7, 2.10, 3.2, 4.3, 6.1a, 6.2, 6.5, 6.6, 8.1, 9.1, 9.3, 9.6, 11.4a, 11.5); 11 verify, 4 have locator defects (R11-R14). 67 locators checked in 13 legally fetched sources; Serre's Trees, Chiswell and INFINITE-WORDS not verifiable (paywalled). The PR's six corrections were checked against IFT p. 28, Definitions 9-10, Notation 42, Lemma 44 and JSJ section 11.1, and hold. Gate FAIL: prnum 1, sorry-data 14, statement-hygiene 6. Depcheck: 206 roadmaps, 1898 edges, 0 problems. Suggested.lean elaborates with 86 sorry warnings and nothing else. One-tactic probe: 6 declarations tried, none closed. P1: section 11.3 basicSeq_fix is false for m,n>=1 because IFT section 7.1 formulas fix the coefficient-first word of IFT (71), not the section 6.5 form (checked by free reduction). P2: sorry-data; headlines stated on stand-ins for carriers and theorems the pinned Tau Ceti 2fd255d already has; section 7.7 headline statable (probe elaborates) but absent; section 11.5 stated only as a genus-two instance; ClassifyingSpaces Stage 2.7 citation dropped by open PRs #1807 and #1808 while TauCeti.PresentationComplex exists at the pin. Ownership against open PRs checked: no second owner; SurfaceTopology consumes sections 2.2, 2.2a and 6.0a-6.0d by section. Nine source errata recorded (IFT, KM02).
